title: wholesome nutty egyptian french lentils stone-bowl-dolsot
description: a nutty, crumbly, energizing egyptian dish featuring french lentils, served in a stone-bowl-dolsot for a fun and interactive meal.
instructions: heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
add the lentils, caraway seeds, cumin powder, coriander powder, salt, and black pepper. stir to combine.
add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
stir in lemon juice and chopped parsley.
meanwhile, preheat the stone-bowl-dolsot in the oven at 400f (200c) for 10 minutes.
remove the stone-bowl-dolsot from the oven and carefully place the cooked lentil mixture into it.
sprinkle crushed pita breadcrumbs on top of the lentil mixture.
serve immediately, so the breadcrumbs stay crunchy.
